43 /**
44  * Normalize specialist skill name to one of the five, or null.
45  * @param {*} name
46  * @returns {string|null}
47  */
48 export function normalizeCommissionSkill(name) {
49   if (name == null || name === '') return null;
50   const raw = String(name).trim();
51   if (COMMISSION_SKILLS.includes(raw)) return raw;
52   const key = raw.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '');
53   const spaced = raw.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '_');
54   return SKILL_ALIASES[key] ?? SKILL_ALIASES[spaced] ?? SKILL_ALIASES[raw.toLowerCase()] ?? null;
55 }

57 /**
58  * Build a compose-only spawn contract for one specialist skill.
59  * Does NOT run Shark Tank, wave loops, or any in-process specialist engine.
60  *
61  * @param {{
62  *   skill: string,
63  *   depth_cell?: string|null,
64  *   depth?: string|null,
65  *   active_effort?: string|null,
66  *   receipt_envelope?: object|null,
67  *   receipt?: object|null,
68  *   project_cwd?: string|null,
69  *   seats?: object|null,
70  *   prefs?: object|null,
71  *   env?: object,
72  *   commission_id?: string|null,
73  * }} input
74  * @returns {object}
75  */
76 export function buildCommission(input = {}) {
77   const skill = normalizeCommissionSkill(input.skill);
78   if (!skill) {
79     return {
80       ok: false,
81       error: 'unknown_commission_skill',
82       message: `Commission skill must be one of: ${COMMISSION_SKILLS.join(', ')}`,
83       compose_only: true,
84       allowed_skills: [...COMMISSION_SKILLS],
85     };
86   }
87 
88   const seats =
89     input.seats && typeof input.seats === 'object'
90       ? input.seats
91       : resolveSeats({
92           prefs: input.prefs ?? null,
93           env: input.env,
94           prefsPath: input.prefsPath,
95           exists: input.exists,
96           readFile: input.readFile,
97         });
98 
99   if (seats.ok === false) {
100     return {
101       ok: false,
102       error: seats.error ?? 'seat_resolution_failed',
103       message: seats.message ?? 'Seat resolution failed for commission',
104       compose_only: true,
105       skill,
106       seats,
107     };
108   }
109 
110   if (!isProductionSeatSafe(seats)) {
111     return {
112       ok: false,
113       error: 'unsafe_production_seat',
114       message:
115         'Production seats must be subscription CLIs only (no product IDs, no XAI_API_KEY HTTP path)',
116       compose_only: true,
117       skill,
118       seats,
119     };
120   }
121 
122   const depth_cell = input.depth_cell ?? input.depth ?? null;
123   const active_effort = input.active_effort ?? null;
124   const receipt_envelope =
125     input.receipt_envelope ?? input.receipt ?? null;
126   const commission_id =
127     input.commission_id ??
128     `ecgberht-commission-${skill}-${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
129 
130   // Spawn contract only — caller (host/orchestrator) may invoke the named skill.
131   // Ecgberht never reimplements specialist loops here.
132   return {
133     ok: true,
134     compose_only: true,
135     kind: 'compose_spawn',
136     skill,
137     depth_cell,
138     active_effort,
139     receipt_envelope,
140     commission_id,
141     project_cwd: input.project_cwd ?? null,
142     seats: {
143       coding_family: seats.coding_family,
144       review_family: seats.review_family,
145       default_cli: seats.default_cli ?? null,
146       coding_driver: seats.coding_driver,
147       review_driver: seats.review_driver,
148       cross_model: seats.cross_model,
149       subscription_only: true,
150       xai_http_seat: false,
151       product_model_ids: [],
152     },
153     // Explicit negatives: adapters are hooks, not engines
154     in_process_shark_tank: false,
155     in_process_wave_loop: false,
156     spawns_specialist: true,
157     executes_in_process: false,
158     product_model_ids: findProductModelIds(seats),
159   };
160 }

162 /**
163  * Interpret a specialist handback into a structured receipt path.
164  * Missing required fields → receipt-validate fails (via validateHandback).
165  *
166  * @param {*} handback
167  * @param {{ skill?: string, depth_cell?: string|null, commission_id?: string|null, as_of?: string }} [meta]
168  */
169 export function interpretHandback(handback, meta = {}) {
170   if (handback == null || typeof handback !== 'object' || Array.isArray(handback)) {
171     return {
172       ok: false,
173       error: 'handback_not_object',
174       message: 'Handback must be a structured object',
175       receipt: null,
176     };
177   }
178 
179   const receipt = buildHandbackReceipt({
180     as_of: handback.as_of ?? meta.as_of,
181     active_effort: handback.active_effort,
182     why_next: handback.why_next,
183     grasscatch_why:
184       handback.grasscatch_why !== undefined ? handback.grasscatch_why : null,
185     tool_depth_why: handback.tool_depth_why,
186     human_wait: handback.human_wait,
187     uncertainty_flags: handback.uncertainty_flags,
188     skill: handback.skill ?? meta.skill ?? null,
189     depth: handback.depth ?? handback.depth_cell ?? meta.depth_cell ?? null,
190     commission_id: handback.commission_id ?? meta.commission_id ?? null,
191     partial: handback.partial === true,
192   });
193 
194   const validated = validateReceipt(receipt);
195   return {
196     ok: validated.ok,
197     error: validated.ok ? null : validated.error,
198     message: validated.ok
199       ? 'Handback validated as structured receipt'
200       : validated.message,
201     issues: validated.issues ?? [],
202     receipt: validated.ok ? validated.receipt : receipt,
203     validation: validated,
204   };
205 }
206 
207 /**
208  * Validate a handback receipt (direct or via build).
209  * @param {*} handback
210  */
211 export function validateHandback(handback) {
212   if (handback && handback.kind === 'handback') {
213     return validateReceipt(handback);
214   }
215   return interpretHandback(handback).validation ?? validateReceipt(handback);
216 }

218 /**
219  * Factory: named compose-only adapter for one skill.
220  * @param {string} skillName
221  */
222 function makeAdapter(skillName) {
223   const skill = normalizeCommissionSkill(skillName);
224   return Object.freeze({
225     skill,
226     compose_only: true,
227     /** Spawn/handback contract only — never runs specialist engines in-process. */
228     buildCommission(input = {}) {
229       return buildCommission({ ...input, skill });
230     },
231     interpretHandback(handback, meta = {}) {
232       return interpretHandback(handback, { ...meta, skill });
233     },
234     interpretExit(code, handback, meta = {}) {
235       const hb = interpretHandback(handback, { ...meta, skill });
236       if (code !== 0) {
237         return {
238           ok: false,
239           status: 'fail',
240           exit_code: code,
241           compose_only: true,
242           skill,
243           handback: hb,
244         };
245       }
246       if (!hb.ok) {
247         return {
248           ok: false,
249           status: 'fail',
250           exit_code: code,
251           compose_only: true,
252           skill,
253           handback: hb,
254           error: 'handback_receipt_invalid',
255         };
256       }
257       const partial = handback?.partial === true;
258       return {
259         ok: true,
260         status: partial ? 'partial' : 'success',
261         exit_code: code,
262         compose_only: true,
263         skill,
264         handback: hb,
265       };
266     },
267   });
268 }

301 /**
302  * Export names that must NEVER appear as implemented specialist engines.
303  * Used by boundary canaries (definition sites only).
304  */
305 export const FORBIDDEN_REIMPLEMENT_EXPORTS = Object.freeze([
306   'runSharkTank',
307   'runForemanWaves',
308   'runWaveLoop',
309   'executeWaveLoop',
310   'runInProcessSharkTank',
311 ]);
312 
313 /**
314  * Boundary canaries: openclaw / daemon / Shark-tank reimplementation / compose hooks.
315  * @param {string} engineDir
316  * @param {{ skillRoot?: string }} [opts]
317  */
318 export function runBoundaryCanaries(engineDir, opts = {}) {
319   const harness = runHarnessCanaries(engineDir);
320   const shark_hits = [];
321   const product_id_hits = [];
322   const xai_http_hits = [];
323   const scanned = [...(harness.scanned || [])];
324 
325   const dir = path.resolve(engineDir);
326   const files = listEngineSources(dir);
327 
328   // Definition / assignment of forbidden reimplementation entrypoints
329   const reimplDef =
330     /(?:export\s+)?(?:async\s+)?function\s+(runSharkTank|runForemanWaves|runWaveLoop|executeWaveLoop|runInProcessSharkTank)\b|(?:export\s+const|const|let|var)\s+(runSharkTank|runForemanWaves|runWaveLoop|executeWaveLoop|runInProcessSharkTank)\s*=/;
331 
332   // Product model IDs in non-comment code (assignment / property value context)
333   const productIdAssign =
334     /(?:model(?:_?id|_?name)?|MODEL)\s*[:=]\s*['"`][^'"`]*(?:claude-(?:opus|sonnet|haiku)|claude-3|gemini-[\d.]+|grok-[234])[^'"`]*['"`]/i;
335 
336   // Production seat using XAI_API_KEY as live seat path (not ban documentation)
337   const xaiSeatUse =
338     /(?:process\.env\.XAI_API_KEY|env\.XAI_API_KEY)\s*(?:=|\|\||\?\?|&&)/;
339 
340   for (const file of files) {
341     const rel = path.relative(dir, file).split(path.sep).join('/');
342     if (!scanned.includes(rel)) scanned.push(rel);
343     let text;
344     try {
345       text = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
346     } catch {
347       continue;
348     }
349     const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/);
350     lines.forEach((line, idx) => {
351       const trimmed = line.trim();
352       const code = trimmed.replace(/\/\/.*$/, '').trim();
353       if (
354         !code ||
355         code.startsWith('*') ||
356         code.startsWith('/*') ||
357         code.startsWith('#')
358       ) {
359         return;
360       }
361       // Skip pure string arrays that list forbidden names for canary detection
362       if (
363         /FORBIDDEN_REIMPLEMENT_EXPORTS|PRODUCT_MODEL_ID_PATTERNS|runBoundaryCanaries/.test(
364           code,
365         )
366       ) {
367         return;
368       }
369       if (reimplDef.test(code)) {
370         shark_hits.push({
371           file: path.basename(file),
372           line: idx + 1,
373           text: trimmed.slice(0, 120),
374         });
375       }
376       if (productIdAssign.test(code)) {
377         product_id_hits.push({
378           file: path.basename(file),
379           line: idx + 1,
380           text: trimmed.slice(0, 120),
381         });
382       }
383       if (xaiSeatUse.test(code)) {
384         xai_http_hits.push({
385           file: path.basename(file),
386           line: idx + 1,
387           text: trimmed.slice(0, 120),
388         });
389       }
390     });
391   }
392 
393   // Compose hooks present for the five named skills
394   const compose_hooks = {};
395   for (const skill of COMMISSION_SKILLS) {
396     const adapter = COMMISSION_ADAPTERS[skill];
397     compose_hooks[skill] = Boolean(
398       adapter &&
399         adapter.compose_only === true &&
400         typeof adapter.buildCommission === 'function' &&
401         typeof adapter.interpretHandback === 'function',
402     );
403   }
404   const missing_hooks = COMMISSION_SKILLS.filter((s) => !compose_hooks[s]);
405 
406   // Adapters must not export forbidden reimplementation names
407   const adapter_export_violations = [];
408   for (const skill of COMMISSION_SKILLS) {
409     const adapter = COMMISSION_ADAPTERS[skill];
410     for (const bad of FORBIDDEN_REIMPLEMENT_EXPORTS) {
411       if (adapter && typeof adapter[bad] === 'function') {
412         adapter_export_violations.push({ skill, export: bad });
413       }
414     }
415   }
416 
417   const ok =
418     harness.ok &&
419     shark_hits.length === 0 &&
420     product_id_hits.length === 0 &&
421     xai_http_hits.length === 0 &&
422     missing_hooks.length === 0 &&
423     adapter_export_violations.length === 0;
424 
425   return {
426     ok,
427     openclaw_hits: harness.openclaw_hits ?? [],
428     daemon_hits: harness.daemon_hits ?? [],
429     shark_hits,
430     product_id_hits,
431     xai_http_hits,
432     compose_hooks,
433     missing_hooks,
434     adapter_export_violations,
435     commission_skills: [...COMMISSION_SKILLS],
436     scanned,
437     receipt_schema_id: RECEIPT_SCHEMA_ID,
438     handback_required_fields: [...HANDBACK_REQUIRED_FIELDS],
439     message: ok
440       ? 'Boundary canaries green: compose-only hooks, no openclaw/daemon/shark reimpl, no product-ID seats'
441       : 'Boundary canary failed',
442   };
443 }

445 function listEngineSources(dir) {
446   const out = [];
447   let entries = [];
448   try {
449     entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
450   } catch {
451     return out;
452   }
453   for (const ent of entries) {
454     const p = path.join(dir, ent.name);
455     if (ent.isDirectory()) {
456       if (ent.name === 'node_modules' || ent.name === '.git') continue;
457       out.push(...listEngineSources(p));
458     } else if (ent.isFile() && /\.(mjs|js|cjs)$/.test(ent.name)) {
459       out.push(p);
460     }
461   }
462   return out;
463 }
